name: Last Call extends Valkyr's Calling's duration by 1 second (#1118)
contract: Last Call 681448 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 33) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_DURATION (1), EffectSpellClassMask word C = 2097152 (bit 21), EffectBasePoints 999 resolving to +1000 (milliseconds) with DieSides 1. Valkyr's Calling 520024 carries SpellFamilyFlags word C = 2097152, the exact same bit, so SpellInfo::IsAffected(33, mask) admits it; SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod additionally exempts SPELLMOD_DURATION from its IsAffectedBySpellMods() gate. Native path: Player::ApplySpellMod's SPELLMOD_DURATION branch adds the flat modifier before any percent multiplier, with no script required. This scenario drives that call through the harness's spell_modifier metric.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Valkyr's Calling duration modifier is zero before the talent
Last Call adds 1000ms to Valkyr's Calling's duration
